reason: Article 9 of the EU AI Act pertains to the obligations of Distributors and Importers. It does not address the technical requirements for resilience, capacity, or fallback mechanisms.
Article 15 of the EU AI Act outlines the obligations of Users. It does not contain provisions for the technical resilience, capacity, or fallback mechanisms of the AI system itself.

Article 17 of the EU AI Act details the obligations of Providers of high-risk AI systems. While it mandates risk management, it does not specifically require the provision of capacity, redundancy, fail-safe, recovery, or manual fallback.
